title.narrative: Global Opportunities for the Long-Term Development of the Artisanal and Small-Scale Gold Mining Sector in Paraguay - planetGOLD Paraguay

description.narrative: Note: Disbursement data provided is cumulative and covers disbursement made by the project Agency.

This project aims to reduce mercury pollution and mitigate the environmental and social impacts of ASGM in Paraguay. A significant aspect of this is increasing the professionalization of the mining sector and adjacent organizations, for greater operational efficiency, environmental compliance and improved market access for responsibly sourced gold. Professionalization can also foster entrepreneurship, economic diversification and alternative livelihoods by promoting responsible mining practices and diversifying income sources beyond mining. Improved access to finance through formalized channels can further support investments in safer technologies and infrastructure upgrades, reducing occupational risks and improving overall worker safety and health. In addition, the project's focus on social cohesion and community participation will strengthen local governance structures, promote inclusive decision-making processes and empower marginalized groups, including women, by providing them with training, access to resources and creating more equitable opportunities within the ASGM sector. Overall, these interventions not only contribute to mercury reduction and environmental protection, but also foster sustainable development, resilience and socio-economic prosperity in mining-affected communities in Paraguay. In line with the above, relevant socio-economic indicators have been included as part of the results logical framework (refer to Appendix C).
To reduce the negative environmental and social impacts caused by intensive mercury use in Paraguay's artisanal and small-scale gold mining (ASGM) sector.
